wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-006 wires the automap start/stop lifecycle, follow/pan/zoom, marker add/clear, the line/thing color palette, and the per-frame state transitions into a single frozen runtime façade. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/automapRuntime.ts imports the read-only automap state machine from src/ui/automap.ts (createAutomapState plus the ftom/mtof scale conversions, boundary walker, follow/scale/pan adjustors, marker helpers, level init, and start/stop transitions) and exposes them through a frozen façade plus a frozen AutomapColors palette descriptor. The state reference is mutable per-tic to match vanilla file-scope automap globals; the façade is frozen.
publicSurface: AutomapRuntime interface (activateNewScale, addMark, changeWindowLoc/Scale, clearMarks, colors, cxMtof, cyMtof, doFollowPlayer, findMinMaxBoundaries, ftom, initVariables, levelInit, maxOutWindowScale, minOutWindowScale, mtof, restoreScaleAndLoc, saveScaleAndLoc, start, state, stop)
